metadata.case_name: CHAN HONG v. FOO YEE NUI

plaintiff.occupation_before: used to look after the household including her grandchildren

source: as a result of which her left femur was fractured.

manifestations.description: as a result of the accident she moves very slowly, cautiously and requires support.
If she attempted to walk without such support she would fall.
There is a half inch shortening of the left leg and limited rotation.
He assessed her impairment of the leg as 5% from shortening and 17% from loss of hip joint movement. This is a 22% impairment of the leg and is a 9% impairment of the whole person.
She is now incapable of any house work and an amah has to be hired for two to three hours morning and evening.
She however can dress herself but obviously is now limited as to her independent movement.
she has to take pills for the Diabetes and she also takes pills because of pain and discomfort resulting from her hip injury.

treatments_received: treatment at Caritas Medical Centre (maintenance charges)
follow-up treatment at Caritas Medical Centre

losses.description: independence of movement has now been considerably reduced.
She is now incapable of any house work and an amah has to be hired for two to three hours morning and evening.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Incable of doing household work; an amah has to be hired for two to three hours morning and evening.
There is a half inch shortening of the left leg and limited rotation; assessed impairment of the leg 22% and whole person 9%.
her life expectation is probably reduced by about half.
